title: k11 API Security QA MCP Server
description:
MCP server and CI tool for API security testing as release evidence: OWASP API Security Top 10 tests generated from an OpenAPI specification and run as test identities (broken object level authorization, broken authentication, mass assignment, sensitive data exposure, function level authorization, misconfiguration), with control requests that make results meaningful, plus SARIF scanner results judged against a baseline and expiring risk acceptances.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-api-security-qa-mcp
